_sources_config_note: Optional.  Per-source toggles live in `sources_config`: { "dcard": { "enabled": true, "forums": ["3c", "trending"] } }.  When `sources_config` is absent (round-1 config) every source defaults to enabled.  When the `sources` array itself is absent the orchestrator defaults to ["ptt"] — round-1 behaviour preserved.  Dcard's network fetch is gated behind `DCARD_FETCH_ENABLED=1` (off by default — see `.env.example`) so CI / sandbox runs stay deterministic.
